title: Reflecting on a Formative Mentor
grammar: Synthesizing causative verb morphology and agent marking in narrative reflection
goal: I can combine transitive (-val/-vel) and intransitive (-t) causative structures in reflective prose
I can express how a mentor shapes habits and intellectual curiosity (rávesz, szoktat, ébreszt)
I can read and analyze an adapted literary excerpt from Mihály Babits's Halálfiai
